notes: Non-secret key registry. Contains NO key material: every key is derived as HKDF(master_secret, key_id) at runtime. Safe to commit and review in a pull request. Run 'synthmark registry stamp' once after adding an entry to fill in its fingerprint, then commit the result -- the fingerprint is what turns a wrong master secret into a loud startup failure instead of a silently undetectable watermark. Entries are only ever ADDED: retiring a key stops generation with it, never detection.

keys.notes: Gemma 4 E4B instruct, general-purpose serving tier.
Distinct key from Gemma: this is what makes a detection hit name the model rather than just the platform.
Larger model, lower output entropy, weaker watermark. Re-calibrate thresholds for this key rather than reusing E4B's.
Pilot key. Retired, but still served for detection: text generated under it still exists and must stay attributable.
